dedupe_keys.name: ivl pso an integer vectorized lightweight particle swarm optimisation algorithm for 27 dimensional microgrid sizing and dispatch on fpu less iot edge devices

description: Surendra Singh publishes an integer-vectorised particle swarm optimisation implementation for microgrid sizing and dispatch. Zenodo lists public Python code, a requirements file, a README document and result tables under CC BY 4.0. The described problem combines a 27-dimensional capacity choice with 24-hour battery dispatch, state-of-charge limits and LiFePO4 degradation cost. Integer arithmetic targets low-power controllers without a floating-point unit, and the paper description reports analytical instruction-cycle estimates for ATmega2560 and ESP32 processors. A modeller can compare embedded optimisation speed and sizing decisions for a specified daily demand. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this algorithm. Coverage is the stated test demand and controller assumptions, not a field-deployed energy management system. A limitation is that the timing is an instruction-level projection, not verified hardware execution; the cost differences are provider claims. Code and result tables were not downloaded or rerun.
